resources.string: With the connection allowed, the SDK reaches Magic Lane Services and activates itself from the project token. Disallow it to simulate a device without internet.
Connection allowed - auto-activation will run once online.
For a device that never goes online. The request blob is generated on-device; the offline_activation_key comes back from Magic Lane Services via the companion app (scan the QR) or your own REST call.
leave empty to let the SDK generate one
Scan with the Magic Lane companion app:
Or send the request yourself, from any online machine:

The activation service URL comes from the services list, which this SDK has not fetched because the connection is disallowed. From any online machine GET the services list, take the entry with \"service_id\": 3 and type one of its \"URLs\" below:
The response carries \"%1$s\" - paste it below.
Activation request blob ready. Scan the QR with the companion app, or send the REST request.
Offline activation completed - the SDK is activated.
Releases this device\'s activation without going online, e.g. to decommission it or reuse its license key. The device stops being activated as soon as the blob is produced.
Nothing to deactivate - no active CORE activation on this device.
Deactivation request blob ready. Scan the QR with the companion app, or send the REST request.
Offline deactivation completed - the SDK is no longer activated.

Disallows the connection and deletes this device\'s local activation records, so the SDK reports NOT ACTIVATED like on a first run and every scenario above can be replayed without restarting. Only the local records are dropped - nothing is released at Magic Lane Services; a real device must use the offline deactivation above.
Reset done - offline, no local activations. Replay any scenario above.
No application token is set on the SDK - cannot build the request.
Blob too large for a QR code. Use the raw blob or the REST request below.

The token you provided was rejected. Make sure you provide the correct value, or if you don\'t have a token, check the magiclane.com website, sign up or sign in and generate one. Then input it in the AndroidManifest.xml file.
